hack.root_cause: Pangolin spot price oracle manipulation via custom trading pairs + decimal handling bug
hack.description: Vee Finance lost $34M when an attacker created custom Pangolin trading pairs to manipulate the spot prices Vee Finance used as its sole oracle, with a decimal handling bug silently disabling the protocol's own slippage protection.
